description: Moves a node to a new position in a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING: This reorganizes the flow structure. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Moving nodes affects execution order.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates the operation without moving. Set to false to actually move the node.

flowId.description: The flow ID containing the node

mode.description: How to position relative to target: append (as next sibling), prepend (as previous sibling), insertChildAt (as child at position), insertAfter, insertBefore

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to move

position.description: Position index when using insertChildAt mode

targetNodeId.description: The ID of the target node to move relative to

name: move_node
